statement: The entire audited necessary parent remains unchanged. Every new active rectangle is strictly contained in its chosen original filled shape. A full-source placement has disjoint filled shapes, and sibling inner rectangles are disjoint, so it satisfies global nonoverlap of all active subsets. Inactive profiles remove both corresponding intervals. Each interval start/end is the unchanged original anchor plus its audited inner bound, with exact fixed size; no new coordinate restriction is added. Thus every full-source placement extends to this model. Positives still require complete source clearance/geometry; negatives retain declared nine-original/angle/guard/grid scope.
